text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

It was precisely because both were so 
strong-willed that neither Vodka nor Daiwa 
Scarlet were swayed by the other's 
philosophy, staying true to their own ways 
of life.

Neither willing to yield, the two clash on 
the grand autumn stage... putting 
everything on the line!
